title: Back-to-school: Stock your dorm with PepsiCo food and drinks that fuel you
summary: From snacks with protein to refreshing beverages, fill your dorm room with products that help power study sessions, busy days and everything in between.
body_markdown:
## Make the most of a mini fridge


Space is limited in college dorm rooms, so it’s important to pack wisely. Make the most of a mini fridge by filling it with items designed to fit small spaces. Consider these PepsiCo food and drink options when shopping:


- 12-ounce bottles of Gatorade Lower Sugar and Gatorade Zero offer the same benefits as the larger bottles, but in mini fridge size. Scientifically formulated with Gatorade’s No. 1 proven electrolyte blend, both options hydrate better than water.
- 7.5-ounce Pepsi Mini cans are the perfect size for any occasion. Available in Pepsi Original and Pepsi Zero Sugar, these mini cans deliver the great Pepsi taste you love in a perfectly portioned size. Pair with your favorite snacks or meals, or stock your mini fridge for whenever you want a refreshing beverage.
- 12-ounce bottles of Propel Fitness Water are a compact hydration option containing electrolytes to help retain fluid, plus vitamins B3, B5 and B6, and antioxidant vitamins C and E.
- Sabra Smart Snackers with Hummus and Pretzels are an easy and convenient, pre-portioned snack that fits perfectly in a mini fridge. Every single-serve cup contains 10 grams of protein and an excellent source of fiber. The smooth and creamy hummus pairs perfectly with the crispy pretzels and are offered in delicious flavor varieties like Classic, Roasted Red Pepper and Roasted Garlic.


Looking for drinks that are good for students on-the-go? Use the powdered format. Mix it in a stainless-steel Gatorade Overtime bottle for over 24 hours of insulation. Choose your favorites from the options below – all contain no artificial flavors or added colors.


- Propel Fitness Powder offers the same benefits as the bottled beverage – electrolytes, zero sugar and vitamins – in a convenient, portable packet.
- Gatorade Zero Powder contains the same proven electrolyte blend as Gatorade Thirst Quencher, but with zero sugar.
- Gatorlyte Powder is a rapid rehydration beverage with a specialized 5-electrolyte blend designed to quickly replace fluids and electrolytes lost in sweat.


If the mini fridge you're stocking comes with a mini microwave, try Pasta Roni pasta cups in Butter & Garlic or Parmesan & Romano flavor. Made with corkscrew pasta in a convenient single-serve cup, it’s the perfect snack or part of lunch – ready in just three minutes.
